# Coverage ratchet baseline for check-coverage-ratchet.sh. Monotonic floors --
# these numbers may only go UP. Raise them in the same commit that adds coverage;
# never lower them without an explicit, reviewed justification in the commit
# message.
#
# Why these metrics: the host suites are blind to an upstream change inside a
# replaced owner (run-upstream-reportgap-dryrun.sh demonstrates it), so what
# catches a bad re-port is the C-vs-Zig differential and the full-core parity
# harnesses, NOT raw line coverage of vendored deps. The ratchet therefore guards
# the count of owner functions under differential and the number of full-core
# parity harnesses, so a future change cannot quietly delete them.
#
# Owner functions under the C-vs-Zig differential (extract_oracle.sh FUNCS).
differential_functions=6

# Executables that link the real core through addFullCoreHarness( in
# build/host/steps.zig: the full-core parity lanes plus the pgm_run, pgm_run_asan
# and coverage builds. The floor sits at the measured count, so removing any one
# fails.
fullcore_harness_steps=11

# Owner coverage: distinct src/ owner source lines executed by the instrumented
# keyboardEntryCov harness (frontier + keyboard_state + stack_state owner objects
# built with coverage=true); check-coverage-ratchet.sh prints the measured value
# after `zig build coverage`. This is a COLLAPSE floor, not an exact tracker: llvm-symbolizer resolves a few lines
# differently across runs and LLVM versions, so the floor sits well below the
# measured value with a deliberate margin. It catches an owner losing its
# coverage=true instrumentation (hundreds of lines) but not symbolizer wobble.
# Raise it BY HAND (never --bump) when a real coverage gain lands; only measured
# when a `zig build coverage` build is present.
zig_src_covered_lines=1600
